name: SA Integrations For Google Sheets
author: Sleek Algo

sections.description:
SA Integrations for Google Sheets connects your WordPress site seamlessly with Google Sheets, providing automatic synchronization of data. Whether you’re managing WooCommerce orders, form submissions, or other essential data, this plugin ensures your Google Sheets remain updated in real-time. Designed for flexibility and ease of use, it empowers you to map fields, manage integrations, and streamline workflows directly from your WordPress dashboard.
Elevate your productivity and enjoy effortless data synchronization with a solution built for WordPress users who demand reliability and performance.

🗝️ Key FEATURES:

🎉 Free Version – Features:

  • Seamless integration with the following plugins:
    • WooCommerce
    • Contact form 7
    • wpforms
    • Gravity Forms
  • Create, edit, and delete integrations.
  • Field mapping feature to map spreadsheet columns with source data fields for streamlined data synchronization.
  • Contact Form 7 entries are saved in WordPress and listed under Contact > Entries.

🌟 Premium Version – Features: 🎯

  • All features in the free version and the following
  • Automatically update the Google Sheet row when a WooCommerce order, a Contact Form 7 entry, a Gravity Forms entry or a WPForms entry is edited (editing WPForms entries needs WPForms Pro).
  • Auto Sync per column: choose which columns are rewritten when a record changes.
  • WooCommerce custom order meta fields in the field mapping.
  • File upload fields (Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms) and Gravity Forms List fields in the field mapping.
  • Edit Contact Form 7 entries from the Entries screen. The sheet row is updated too.

Get the premium version now 🚀.

Documentation 📚

Discover how to use the plugin with our detailed and user-friendly documentation.

🌐 Translation Ready 🤩

SA Integrations For Google Sheets is compatible with Loco Translate, WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and more. To contribute, add a new language via translate.wordpress.org.

⏩ Use of Third-Party Libraries 🛠️

The SA Integrations For Google Sheets plugin has been built using the following third-party libraries to enhance functionality and user experience:
– OAuth 2.0 Protocol – This plugin utilizes the OAuth 2.0 protocol to access Google APIs. It requests an access token from the Google Authorization Server using the client credentials of the connected Google account. The token is extracted from the server’s response and included in each Google API request to ensure secure and authorized access.
– PHP-JWT – The plugin uses the PHP-JWT library to encode the request body for generating Google API access tokens as JSON Web Tokens (JWT). This approach adheres to Google’s recommended security practices for enhanced security.
– Google Drive API V3 – This API is used to access the connected Google account and retrieve the list of created sheets. These sheets are then made available for feed management, enabling seamless data synchronization between the site and Google Sheets.
– Google Sheets API V4 – This API is used for reading and writing spreadsheet data. The mapped spreadsheet is automatically updated through the created feed map whenever new data is received at the source, ensuring continuous synchronization between the feed source and Google Sheets.
– Mozart – To prevent conflicts with other plugins, this plugin incorporates the Mozart PHP Composer package as devlopment dependency. Mozart wraps all third-party Composer dependencies into the plugin’s own namespace, ensuring compatibility even when multiple versions of the same package are in use.
– React.js – React.js is used to manage the plugin’s admin interface components for a dynamic and responsive user experience.
– Ant Design – We used Ant Design and Ant Design ProComponents to create a polished and intuitive UI for the plugin’s admin interfaces.
– WordPress Scripts – WordPress Scripts manage the plugin’s build system, as the admin interface is developed in React’s JSX syntax, with builds generated via WordPress’s robust tooling.
– Freemius WordPress SDK – Freemius shows the optional opt-in screen and the upgrade (pricing) page, and in the premium version handles license activation and updates.

External services

This plugin connects to the following services:

  • Google APIs (oauth2.googleapis.com, www.googleapis.com, sheets.googleapis.com). Used to sign in with the service-account key you upload, list your spreadsheets and write rows. Sent: a signed token request from your key, and the values of the fields you mapped, each time a mapped order or form entry is sent or updated. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
  • Freemius (api.freemius.com, wp.freemius.com). Used for the optional opt-in, the upgrade (pricing) page and, in the premium version, license activation and updates. Nothing is sent unless you opt in or activate a license. When you do, it receives your site URL, WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, the admin name and email address, and plugin activation and deactivation events. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

😍 Useful Links 📌

  • Documentation
  • Support Forum
  • Github
  • Translations

Become a Contributor 👨🏻‍💻

SA Integrations For Google Sheets is an open-source project, and we welcome contributors to be part of our vibrant community! Help us improve the plugin and make it even better – GitHub Link.

🤝 Support 👀

We offers full support on the WordPress.org Forum. Before starting a new thread, please check available documentation and other support threads. Leave a clear and concise description of your issue, and we will respond as soon as possible.

🐞 BUG REPORTS 📝

Find a bug in SA Integrations For Google Sheets ? We welcome your bug reports! Please report bugs in the SA Integrations For Google Sheets repository on GitHub. Note that GitHub is not a support forum but an efficient platform for addressing and resolving issues efficiently.
sections.installation:
• In your WordPress dashboard, choose Plugins > Add new.
  • Search for the plugin with the search bar in the top right corner using the keywords “Google Sheets Integrations”. A number of results may appear.
  • After finding the plugin in the results, click Install Now. You can also click the plugin name to view more details about it.

For further details please check our Installation Guide
sections.faq:
Which plugins does it work with?

WooCommerce, Contact Form 7, WPForms (Lite and Pro) and Gravity Forms. Turn on the ones you use in the plugin’s dashboard, then create an integration for each form, or for your WooCommerce orders. Each integration sends one source to one tab of a spreadsheet.

Is the free version limited?

No. You can create as many integrations as you need. The plugin sets no limit on rows or spreadsheets, and there is no trial period. The premium version adds extra features, listed below.

How do I connect Google Sheets?

The plugin connects through a Google service account. In the Google Cloud console, create a project, turn on the Google Sheets API and the Google Drive API, create a service account and download its JSON key. Then upload the key in the plugin’s settings. Signing in with a personal Google account is not supported. The installation guide shows each step.

Why is my spreadsheet missing from the list?

The service account only sees spreadsheets that are shared with it. Open the spreadsheet in Google Sheets, click Share and add the service account’s email address (the client_email shown in the plugin’s settings) as an Editor. Then reload the integration screen.

Does my sheet need a header row?

Yes. The plugin reads the first row of the tab and uses each cell as a column name in the field mapping. Add your column titles to row 1 before you create the integration. New orders and entries are added as new rows below it.

Are existing orders and entries sent?

No. An integration sends the orders and entries created after you save it. Older records are not sent.

When is a WooCommerce order sent?

When the order reaches one of the order statuses you pick in the integration, for example Processing or Completed. Each order is sent once per integration. In the premium version, the row is updated later when the order changes.

Do changes in Google Sheets come back to WordPress?

No. Data goes one way, from WordPress to Google Sheets. Editing the sheet does not change your orders or entries.

Can I see Contact Form 7 submissions in WordPress?

Yes. The plugin saves each Contact Form 7 submission and lists them under Contact > Entries. In the premium version you can also edit an entry there, and its sheet row is updated.

Where is my Google key stored?

In your WordPress database, not as a file on your server. The private key is never shown again on the settings screen, and only administrators can use the plugin’s settings.

What does the premium version add?

Sheet rows are updated when an order or entry is edited, you choose which columns are updated, and you can map WooCommerce custom order fields, file uploads and Gravity Forms List fields. See the premium version.

Will I lose my integrations when I upgrade to premium?

No. The premium version uses the same settings, integrations and entries. When you activate it, the free version is deactivated for you.

Does the plugin send my data anywhere else?

Only to Google, to write the fields you mapped. Freemius receives some site details only if you opt in or activate a premium license. See External services above.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Your Google key and access token are removed. Your integrations and saved Contact Form 7 entries stay in the database, so they are still there if you install the plugin again.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Fix (premium): Contact Form 7 file upload fields wrote a code (the file’s hash) to the sheet instead of a link to the file.
  • Tweak: on the Contact Form 7 Entries page, a file field that is not mapped to a sheet column shows the file name instead of that code.
  • Tweak: HTML and JavaScript uploads are never copied to the plugin’s attachments folder.

1.1.2

  • Fix: in the free version, the Add Integration button was disabled once one integration existed. The free version has no limit on integrations.

1.1.1

  • Fix: the Freemius opt-in, account, pricing and update screens showed a generic plugin icon instead of the plugin’s own icon.

1.1.0

  • New: Freemius SDK. An optional opt-in screen is shown once, and the Upgrade to Premium button opens the pricing page in your dashboard.
  • New: premium version, built from the same code: automatic sheet row updates when an order or entry is edited, Auto Sync per column, WooCommerce custom order meta fields, file upload and Gravity Forms List fields, and Contact Form 7 entry editing.
  • Fix: the Contact Form 7 Entries menu was missing with newer Contact Form 7 versions, which moved their admin menu.
  • Fix: saving an integration now shows the error message when the save fails.
  • Tweak: rewrote the FAQ. The free version has no limit on integrations.
  • Dev: new filters saifgs_source_fields and saifgs_woocommerce_order_field_value, and new action saifgs_sheet_row_appended.
  • Dev: the stored Google key is removed through Freemius’ uninstall hook. uninstall.php was removed.

1.0.1

  • Security: the plugin’s REST API now requires an administrator (manage_options). Before, any logged-in user, such as a customer, could read the Google key and change integrations.
  • Security: the Google service-account key is no longer saved in the public uploads folder. The update deletes the old file and shows a notice recommending a new key.
  • Security: the private key is never sent to the browser, and it is deleted when the plugin is deleted.
  • Security: Contact Form 7 file uploads are copied only when a mapped column needs them, under random names, with directory listing blocked.
  • Fix: the plugin no longer forces Contact Form 7 nonce checks on every form on the site.
  • Fix: WooCommerce orders are sent when they reach a selected status (for example Processing or Completed), not only at checkout. Each order is sent once per integration.
  • Fix: WooCommerce values stay in their mapped columns. Product fields no longer move to the end of the row.
  • Fix: WooCommerce date fields, Tax Total, Product Type and QTY Refunded for Item now fill in. “Product Total” is the line total of each product; a new “Order Total” field holds the order total. “Shipping Status” is renamed “Shipping State”.
  • Fix: a revoked or invalid Google key no longer makes checkout or form submission hang.
  • Fix: Google errors no longer break checkout or form submissions. Spam and aborted Contact Form 7 submissions and Gravity Forms spam are skipped.
  • Fix: turning a plugin off on the Supported Plugins tab now stops its syncing.
  • Fix: sheet tabs whose names contain spaces or other special characters now work.
  • Fix: the spreadsheet picker lists only Google Sheets files, including shared drives, and is no longer limited to 100 files.
  • Fix: the integrations list no longer breaks when WPForms or Gravity Forms is deactivated or a form is deleted.
  • Fix: changes to integrations apply immediately on sites with a persistent object cache.
  • Compatibility: declared compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Compatibility: “Requires PHP” is now 7.4, matching the bundled Google sign-in library (firebase/php-jwt 6), which already needed PHP 7.4.

1.0.0

Initial release.
